answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the prism. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
